## Checklist
- [ ] I have read [`docs/FUNDAMENTAL_RULES.md`](docs/FUNDAMENTAL_RULES.md)
- [ ] My change does **not** weaken rules F1–F10 to make a solver feasible
- [ ] If this affects the building behaviour, I added or updated a regression test
- [ ] `PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests/` passes locally
- [ ] If I changed UI, I tested the GUI manually (`PYTHONPATH=. python ui/main_window.py`)
- [ ] If a design decision was needed, it is recorded in `docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`
- [ ] Code, comments and docs in this PR are in English
